description: JustDial Limited is India's No. 1 local search engine, providing local search-related services across India through website, mobile website, apps (Android and iOS), telephone (8888888888), and SMS. Access to 5.3 crore+ businesses and 5.9 crore+ products and services. One-stop platform for local businesses, services, and stores nearby—covering restaurants, hotels, doctors, real estate, repairs, beauty & spa, wedding planning, education, home decor, hospitals, and more. Features include interactive maps, price comparison, user ratings and reviews, appointment booking, and 'Near Me' location-based search. Additional services: JD Mart (B2B connections), Bills & Recharge (utility payments for insurance, gas, water, DTH, electricity, mobile), travel bookings (hotels, trains, buses, flights), and movie tickets. Available in English, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, and Tamil.
